candidate_rule: two non-promoted evidence candidates per source record: verified fact and explicit scope limitation

documents.title: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026
Quality and Methodology Information for BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026

records.fact: BDUK interventions delivered gigabit-capable coverage to an estimated 192,570 premises during financial year 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: This subsidised-delivery total is not evidence that any particular address is currently serviceable or orderable.

records.fact: Annual delivery increased by 42,280 premises, or 28%, compared with the previous financial year.
records.scope_limit: A year-on-year programme increase cannot identify current network status at a parcel.

records.fact: The estimated cumulative total delivered through BDUK gigabit programmes reached 1,418,410 premises by the end of March 2026.
records.scope_limit: The cumulative programme count does not provide a current UPRN-to-provider service match.

records.fact: Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy contracts accounted for 72% of 2025/26 delivery, representing 139,490 premises.
records.scope_limit: Intervention-level totals do not prove exact-address inclusion, activation or retail availability.

records.fact: Voucher schemes contributed 16% of 2025/26 delivery, representing 30,530 premises.
records.scope_limit: Voucher delivery statistics cannot be treated as a current voucher eligibility or service result for a named premises.

records.fact: Superfast and Hubs interventions accounted for the remaining 12% of delivery, representing 22,550 premises.
records.scope_limit: Programme categories and annual totals do not establish an exact parcel's network technology or orderability.

records.fact: Rural areas represented 90% of annual BDUK delivery, corresponding to 173,190 premises.
records.scope_limit: A rural classification and national total do not identify which individual rural properties were delivered.

records.fact: Residential properties represented 90% of annual delivery, corresponding to 173,270 premises.
records.scope_limit: Premises-type aggregates cannot prove service or subsidy status for a particular home.

records.fact: Commercial properties represented 9% of annual delivery, corresponding to 17,790 premises.
records.scope_limit: The commercial aggregate does not identify any business address, product or provider.

records.fact: England accounted for 75% of annual delivery, representing 145,110 premises.
records.scope_limit: Country-level delivery is not an exact-address availability result.

records.fact: Scotland accounted for 16% of annual delivery, representing 30,530 premises.
records.scope_limit: The country total includes programme reporting limitations and cannot establish service at a parcel.

records.fact: Wales accounted for 8% of annual delivery, representing 15,430 premises.
records.scope_limit: The country aggregate cannot determine exact-premises inclusion or orderability.

records.fact: Northern Ireland accounted for 1% of annual delivery, representing 1,470 premises.
records.scope_limit: The reported share is programme-level evidence and is not a current network check for an address.

records.fact: Within England, the South West recorded the highest 2025/26 delivery with 27,630 premises.
records.scope_limit: Regional delivery totals do not prove that a specific South West address has been connected.

records.fact: Yorkshire and the Humber recorded 27,090 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: A regional count cannot establish exact-address network status.

records.fact: The North West recorded 25,100 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: Regional programme delivery is not equivalent to retail availability at a premises.

records.fact: Cumberland recorded the highest local-authority delivery in 2025/26, with 9,540 premises.
records.scope_limit: A local-authority total cannot identify the delivered UPRNs or current provider products.

records.fact: North Yorkshire recorded 9,170 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: The authority-level count must not be promoted to an individual parcel without UPRN evidence.

records.fact: Westmorland and Furness recorded 8,560 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: The area total does not prove a named property was included, built or activated.

records.fact: East Riding of Yorkshire recorded 7,420 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: Local-authority programme counts are not exact-address service evidence.

records.fact: Highland recorded 6,760 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: The statistic cannot resolve current serviceability for a Highland parcel.

records.fact: Cornwall recorded 6,220 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: The local-authority figure is not a live provider or orderability check.

records.fact: Wiltshire recorded 5,830 premises delivered during 2025/26.
records.scope_limit: The local-authority aggregate cannot be assigned to a specific UPRN.

records.fact: An estimated 43,880 premises, or 23% of 2025/26 delivery, did not previously have superfast broadband of at least 30 Mbit/s.
records.scope_limit: A historical availability category does not establish current speed or retail service at an exact premises.

records.fact: BDUK reports ongoing work to improve identification of addresses without an associated UPRN and separately notes investigation of voucher data quality.
records.scope_limit: The methodological limitation requires conservative use; unmatched or revised records must not be inferred into parcel truth.
